investigations.name: community-cross-feeding
investigations.title: Cross-feeding in a two-species community
investigations.question: Can CRM-constrained dynamic FBA, composed as a multi-species bigraph on a shared nutrient pool, reproduce niche differentiation by cross-feeding rather than competitive exclusion?
investigations.hypothesis: A glucose specialist that overflows acetate under an O2 cap will build a byproduct pool that sustains a distinct acetate specialist, yielding two temporally offset growth phases.
